ns2:section.sectionText: Intended to offer practical experience with modern computerized methods in finance, course will meet concurrently with lab portions of ACE 542 and cover theory of financial decision making and topics related to characterization of real financial problems in a decision making setting. Will emphasize methods dependent on data and numeric methods for characterizing complex functional relationships. Students should have strong familiarity with Excel and at least one statistical/econometrics package. Meets with ACE 542; students may not register for both ACE 542 and ACE 592-FDM.
